description_en: Creates pay-as-you-go or subscription ENS compute instances
description_zh: 创建按量付费或包年包月的ENS计算实例
kebab_example: aliyun ens run-instances --instance-type ens.sn1.small --instance-charge-type PostPaid --image-id m-5si16wo6simkt267p8b7h0000 --net-district-code 350000 --carrier telecom --schedule-area-level Region --scheduling-strategy Concentrate --ens-region-id cn-foshan-telecom --password testPassword --biz-key-pair-name wx2-jumpserver --internet-charge-type BandwidthByDay --system-disk Category=local_ssd Size=50 --data-disk Category=cloud_efficiency KMSKeyId=false Size=20 Encrypted=false --period 1 --internet-max-bandwidth-out 1 --amount 1 --net-work-id net-id --vswitch-id vsw-5sagnw7m613oulalkd10n0000 --security-id sg-test --host-name test-HostName --instance-name TestName --unique-suffix true --user-data ZWtest --auto-renew true --scheduling-price-strategy PriceHighPriority --private-ip-address 10.0.XX.XX --period-unit Month --public-ip-identification true --password-inherit false --instance-charge-strategy instance --billing-cycle Day --ip-type ipv4 --auto-use-coupon true --tag Value=tagValue Key=team --auto-release-time 2023-06-28T14:38:52Z --spot-strategy SpotAsPriceGo --spot-duration 1 --ipv6-address-count 2 --deletion-protection false --launch-template-id lt-test --launch-template-name lt-test --launch-template-version 2 --vpd-id vpd-5s7xxxxxxx --vpd-vswitchids vsw-5s7xxxxxxx --deployment-set-id ds-5s1p6x2l3r4b0000 --auto-install-cloud-assistant true --cloud-assistant-region cn-zhangjiakou --region cn-hangzhou
name: RunInstances

parameters.help_en: The instance type
parameters.help_zh: 实例规格
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:
PrePaid: subscription.
PostPaid: pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh:
实例付费方式。取值：
PrePaid：预付费，包年包月。
PostPaid：按量付费
parameters.name: instance_charge_type

parameters.help_en: The image ID. This parameter cannot be specified for ARM-based instances. This parameter is required for other instance types
parameters.help_zh: 镜像ID。arm版卡不能填，其他类型规格必填
parameters.name: image_id

parameters.help_en:
The region code.
This parameter is required for region-level scheduling and is invalid for node-level scheduling
parameters.help_zh:
地区Code。
区域级调度时必填，节点级调度时无效
parameters.name: net_district_code

parameters.help_en:
The carrier.
This parameter is required for region-level scheduling.</br>
For node-level scheduling, if a node has multiple carriers and you do not specify a carrier, instances are created for each carrier on the node. For example, if a node has both China Mobile and China Unicom carriers, instances with two ISPs are created.</br>You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2637461.html to query the carrier information of a node
parameters.help_zh:
运营商。
区域级调度时必填。</br>
在节点级调度时如果是节点存在多运营商场景时，如果不输入运营商则会按节点的运营商进行生产，如有移动、联通两个运营商，则生产出来的实例有两个ISP。</br>您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2637461.html获取节点运营商信息
parameters.name: carrier

parameters.help_en:
The scheduling level. Use this parameter to specify node-level or region-level scheduling. Valid values:

Big: major area
Middle: province
Small: city
Region: node
parameters.help_zh:
调度层级。通过该字段来执行节点级调度或者区域调度。取值：

Big：大区
Middle：省份
Small：城市
Region：节点
parameters.name: schedule_area_level

parameters.help_en:
The scheduling strategy. Valid values:

Concentrate: concentrated
Disperse: dispersed

For node-level scheduling, the value is Concentrate. For region-level scheduling, select a value based on your requirements
parameters.help_zh:
调度策略。取值：

Concentrate：集中
Disperse：分散

节点级调度时，为Concentrate；区域级调度时，按客户需求选择
parameters.name: scheduling_strategy

parameters.help_en:
The node ID.

This parameter is required for node-level scheduling and is invalid for region-level scheduling
parameters.help_zh:
节点ID。

节点级调度时必填，区域级调度时无效
parameters.name: ens_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance password.

Specify at least one of Password, KeyPairName, and PasswordInherit
parameters.help_zh:
实例密码。

Password、KeyPairName、PasswordInherit至少填入一个
parameters.name: password

parameters.help_en:
The key pair name.
Specify at least one of Password, KeyPairName, and PasswordInherit
parameters.help_zh:
密钥对名称。
Password、KeyPairName、PasswordInherit至少填入一个
parameters.name: key_pair_name

parameters.help_en:
Billable methods for bandwidth. Valid values:
BandwidthByDay: daily peak bandwidth
95BandwidthByMonth: monthly 95th percentile bandwidth

You can select a billing method only for the first purchase. Subsequent purchases use the billing method selected during the first purchase by default
parameters.help_zh:
带宽计费方式。取值：
BandwidthByDay：日峰值带宽
95BandwidthByMonth：月95峰值带宽

如果是第一次新购时可以进行选择计费方式，后续此字段值会根据第一次所选择的计费方式进行默认处理
parameters.name: internet_charge_type

fields.help_en: The type of the system cloud disk
fields.name: category

fields.help_en: The size of the system cloud disk. Unit: GiB
fields.name: size

parameters.help_en: The system cloud disk specifications
parameters.help_zh: 系统盘规格
parameters.name: system_disk

fields.help_en:
The disk category. Valid values:
cloud_efficiency: ultra cloud disk
cloud_ssd: all-flash cloud disk
local_hdd: local HDD
local_ssd: local SSD
fields.help_zh:
磁盘种类。取值：
cloud_efficiency：高效云盘
cloud_ssd：全闪云盘
local_hdd：本地HDD盘
local_ssd：本地SSD盘
fields.name: category

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to encrypt the cloud disk. Valid values:

true: encrypts the cloud disk.

false (default): does not encrypt the cloud disk
fields.help_zh:
是否加密云盘。取值范围：

true：是

false（默认值）：否
fields.name: encrypted

fields.help_en:
The ID of the KMS key used by the cloud disk. Valid values:

true: encrypts the cloud disk.

false (default): does not encrypt the cloud disk.

If Encrypted is set to true and KMSKeyId is empty, the default service key is used
fields.help_zh:
云盘使用的KMS密钥ID。取值范围：

true：是

false（默认值）：否

如果Encrypted置为true，KMSKeyId为空时则使用服务默认密钥
fields.name: kms_key_id

fields.help_en: The size of the data cloud disk. Unit: GiB
fields.name: size

parameters.help_en: The data cloud disk specifications
parameters.help_zh: 数据盘规格
parameters.name: data_disk

parameters.help_en:
The duration of the purchased resource.

If PeriodUnit is set to Day, Period can only be set to 3.

If PeriodUnit is set to Month, Period can be set to 1-9 or 12
parameters.help_zh:
购买资源的时长。

如果PeriodUnit取值为Day时，则Period仅可设置为3。

如果PeriodUnit取值为Month时，则Period可设置为1-9,12
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en: The maximum public bandwidth. If the value of this parameter is greater than 0, a public IP address is automatically assigned to the instance
parameters.help_zh: 公网最大带宽，如果本参数的值大于0，则自动为实例分配公网IP
parameters.name: internet_max_bandwidth_out

parameters.help_en: The number of instances to create. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 创建的实例数量。取值范围：1~100
parameters.name: amount

parameters.help_en:
The network ID.

This parameter can only be used for node-level scheduling. An error is returned if this parameter is specified for region-level scheduling. If you do not specify vSwitch information, only the validity of the network ID is verified. The actual resource creation does not use this network ID
parameters.help_zh:
网络ID。

只能在节点级调度使用，区域级调度时配置该参数会报错。如果不指定交换机信息时，则只会校验网络ID是否合法，实际资源生产并不以此网络ID为准
parameters.name: net_work_id

parameters.help_en:
The vSwitch ID.

This parameter can only be used for node-level scheduling. An error is returned if this parameter is specified for region-level scheduling
parameters.help_zh:
交换机ID。

只能在节点级调度使用，区域级调度时配置该参数会报错
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The security group ID
parameters.help_zh: 安全组ID
parameters.name: security_id

parameters.help_en: The hostname
parameters.help_zh: 主机名称
parameters.name: host_name

parameters.help_en:
The instance name. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter or Chinese character. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. It can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), or hyphens (-).

Default value: the InstanceId of the instance
parameters.help_zh:
实例名称。长度为2~128个字符，必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。可以包含中文、英文、数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、点号（.）或者连字符（-）。

默认值为实例的InstanceId
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to add sequential suffixes to HostName and InstanceName. The sequential suffixes start from 001 and cannot exceed 999
parameters.help_zh: 是否为HostName和InstanceName添加有序后缀，有序后缀从001开始递增，最大不能超过999
parameters.name: unique_suffix

parameters.help_en: The custom user data. Maximum size: 16 KB. You can pass in UserData information. UserData is Base64-encoded
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义数据，最大支持16 KB。您可传入UserData信息，UserData以Base64的方式编码
parameters.name: user_data

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:

true: enables auto-renewal.
false: does not enable auto-renewal. (Default)

This parameter is invalid for pay-as-you-go instances
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动续费。取值：

true：自动续费
false：不自动续费（默认）

按量付费时，该参数无效
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
The scheduling price strategy. Valid values:

PriceHighPriority: high price first
PriceLowPriority: low price first
parameters.help_zh:
调度价格策略。取值：

PriceHighPriority：优先高价
PriceLowPriority：优先低价
parameters.name: scheduling_price_strategy

parameters.help_en:
The private IP address.
This parameter can only be used for node-level scheduling. An error is returned if this parameter is specified for region-level scheduling.
If a private IP address is specified, the number of instances can only be 1. The private IP address takes effect only when both the private IP address and vSwitch ID are specified
parameters.help_zh:
私网IP地址。
只能在节点级调度使用，区域级调度时配置该参数会报错。
如果指定了私网IP，实例数量只能为1台，且私网IP和交换机ID同时非空时，该私网IP才生效
parameters.name: private_ip_address

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the purchase duration. Valid values:
Month (default): monthly purchase.
Day: daily purchase
parameters.help_zh:
购买资源的时长单位。取值：
Month（默认）：按月购买。
Day：按天购买
parameters.name: period_unit

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable public IP identification. Valid values:

true: enables public IP identification.

false: does not enable public IP identification.

Default value: true
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用公网ipidentification。
取值：

true：启用。

false：不启用

默认值：true
parameters.name: public_ip_identification

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the preset password of the image. Valid values:

true: uses the preset password.
false: does not use the preset password.

Specify at least one of Password, KeyPairName, and PasswordInherit
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用镜像预置密码。取值：

true：使用
false：不使用

Password、KeyPairName、PasswordInherit至少填入一个
parameters.name: password_inherit

parameters.help_en:
The instance billing strategy. Valid values:

instance: instance-level billing.
If not specified, the default is user-level billing
parameters.help_zh:
实例计费策略。取值：

instance：实例粒度
不传默认按用户维度
parameters.name: instance_charge_strategy

parameters.help_en:
The billing cycle for instance compute resources. Only instance-level pay-as-you-go is supported. Valid values:

Day: daily billing.

Month: monthly billing
parameters.help_zh:
实例计算资源计费周期，仅支持实例级后付费。
取值

Day：按天计费。

Month：按月计费
parameters.name: billing_cycle

parameters.help_en:
The IP type. Valid values:

ipv4 (default): IPv4.

ipv6: IPv6.

ipv4Andipv6: IPv4 and IPv6 (single stack).
ipv4Withipv6: IPv4 and IPv6 (dual-stack)
parameters.help_zh:
IP类型。取值：

ipv4（默认值）：IPv4。

ipv6：IPv6。

ipv4Andipv6：IPv4和IPv6(单栈)。
ipv4Withipv6：IPv4和IPv6(双栈)
parameters.name: ip_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to use coupons. Default value: true (AutoUseCoupon=true)
parameters.help_zh: 是否使用代金券，默认为使用，即AutoUseCoupon=true
parameters.name: auto_use_coupon

fields.help_en: The tag value. The tag value cannot exceed 128 characters in length, and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, or contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 标签值。不可超过128个字符，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tags that are bound to the instance
parameters.help_zh: 实例所绑定的标签
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en:
The automatic release time of the pay-as-you-go instance. Specify the time in the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html standard in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format. The time must be in UTC.

If the value of seconds (`ss`) is not `00`, the time is automatically set to the start of the current minute (`mm`).

The earliest release time is one hour after the current time
parameters.help_zh:
按量付费实例的自动释放时间。按照https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html标准表示，使用UTC+0时间。格式为：0。

如果秒（`ss`）取值不是`00`，则自动取为当前分钟（`mm`）开始时。

最短释放时间为当前时间一小时之后
parameters.name: auto_release_time

parameters.help_en:
The bidding policy for the pay-as-you-go instance. This parameter takes effect when the `InstanceChargeType` parameter is set to `PostPaid`. Valid values:

NoSpot: a regular pay-as-you-go instance.
SpotAsPriceGo: the system automatically bids at the current market price.

Default value: NoSpot
parameters.help_zh:
按量付费实例的竞价策略。当参数`InstanceChargeType`取值为`PostPaid`时生效。取值范围：

NoSpot：正常按量付费实例。
SpotAsPriceGo：系统自动出价，跟随当前市场实际价格。

默认值：NoSpot
parameters.name: spot_strategy

parameters.help_en:
The protection period of the spot instance.

Unit: hours
parameters.help_zh:
抢占式实例保护期。

单位：小时
parameters.name: spot_duration

parameters.help_en: The number of randomly generated IPv6 addresses to assign to the primary ENI of the private network
parameters.help_zh: 为私网主网卡指定随机生成的ipv6地址数量
parameters.name: ipv6_address_count

parameters.help_en:
The release protection property of the instance. Specifies whether the instance can be released from the console or by calling an API operation. Valid values: 

true: Enables instance release protection.
false: Disables instance release protection.

Default value: false.

This property applies only to pay-as-you-go instances and can only restrict manual release operations. It does not take effect on system-initiated release operations
parameters.help_zh:
实例释放保护属性，指定是否支持通过控制台或API释放实例。取值范围： 

true：开启实例释放保护。
false：关闭实例释放保护。

默认值：false。

该属性仅适用于按量付费实例，且只能限制手动释放操作，对系统释放操作不生效
parameters.name: deletion_protection

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance launch template
parameters.help_zh: 实例启动模板ID
parameters.name: launch_template_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the instance launch template
parameters.help_zh: 实例启动模板名称
parameters.name: launch_template_name

parameters.help_en: The version of the instance launch template
parameters.help_zh: 实例启动模板版本
parameters.name: launch_template_version

parameters.help_en: The VPD network ID
parameters.help_zh: VPD 网络 ID
parameters.name: vpd_id

parameters.help_en: The list of VPD vSwitch IDs
parameters.help_zh: VPD 交换机 ID 列表
parameters.name: vpd_vswitchids

parameters.help_en: The deployment set ID
parameters.help_zh: 部署集 ID
parameters.name: deployment_set_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to automatically install the Cloud Assistant client on the instance
parameters.help_zh: 是否为实例自动安装云助手客户端
parameters.name: auto_install_cloud_assistant

parameters.help_en: The region for Cloud Assistant access. Valid values: cn-zhangjiakou (Zhangjiakou) and ap-southeast-1 (Singapore)
parameters.help_zh: 接入云助手的地域。取值：cn-zhangjiakou（张家口）、ap-southeast-1（新加坡）
parameters.name: cloud_assistant_region
